# Meridian

Meridian turns a saved SQL query into a report that arrives on a schedule. The
marketing pages below are public. The application itself is behind a session and
is not listed here, because a URL that returns a sign-in redirect to anyone who
has not authenticated is not a document anything can read.

## Pages

- [Product overview](https://example.com/): what Meridian does and who runs it.
- [Plans](https://example.com/pricing): the three tiers and what separates them.
- [API reference](https://example.com/api-docs): the four endpoints, their
  parameters, and their error codes.
- [Release notes](https://example.com/changelog): dated entries, newest first.

## Notes

- Rate limits and authentication for the API are documented on the API reference
  page rather than repeated here.
- Questions that these pages do not answer go to the address published on the
  product overview.
